message.text:
The scheduler package contains a daily-cleanup example set to 2 AM. It is not wired into the server.

No nightly database-cleanup job is registered. The only background job is s3presign, which runs every 12 hours. I am confirming the scheduler is never constructed or started in production.

message.text: No nightly database-cleanup job exists. The scheduler package is unused in production. The "0 2 * * *" cron expression appears only as an unregistered documentation example named "daily-cleanup".

r03.
There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job and no scheduled cleanup time.

`internal/scheduler` is a library only; production never constructs or starts it (`server/server.go` runs `s3presign` every 12 hours instead). `"0 2 * * *"` / `"daily-cleanup"` appears only as a package example in `internal/scheduler/doc.go`, not as a registered DB job.
